title: Hiring: the job description, the funnel and the time it really takes

videos.script: Agenda gets an eighth engineer. Renata finds the last job description for a similar role. Fourteen requirements, one page. {{title}} She starts again from one question. What will this person actually do in their first six months? {{six}} Three requirements come out of the answer. Not fourteen. Every extra one removes people who could have done the job, and removes them unevenly. {{musts}} Then the funnel. Two hundred and forty applications, one accepted offer. {{funnel}} And the time. Nine weeks to an offer, a month of notice, and more than two weeks of the team's hours. {{time}} This lesson is about all three. And about week six, when somebody asks if the bar could drop a little. {{bar}}
